answer: A concrete defense is mirror replay with burner stakes. Each account periodically gets a random subset of its past jobs to re-execute, and output must match the earlier submission exactly; a mirror run that diverges flags it. Replay is cheap for honest agents doing deterministic work, but a sybil that fabricated outputs cannot reproduce them without really computing. A challenged account must also post a cedar-grade stake that burns while the dispute is open, and the lantern of public audit logs lets any peer recheck the replay, while honest agents just show their record.
